name: The Everstill Bridge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor.  We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.

Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt.  If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, adventurer, I'll make sure you're rewarded.

Now let's get to work!
narrative.objectives: Bring 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets to Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Great work, adventurer. These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely. We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
narrative.requestItemsText: This bridge isn't going to build itself! Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 16 to 20, 2,425 XP in all.

quests.name: The Lost Tools
quests.objectiveText: Foreman Oslow of Lakeshire wants you to retrieve his toolbox from the bottom of Lake Everstill.
